notes.title: V3.0.20 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We've got a new update coming your way!
The main contents of this update are as follows (October 15th):
1. New language added into the game: Polish is available now.
2. Corrected the description for Ivan's [Aid] Level 1 skill in story mode.
3. Adjusted the refresh locations for the quests 'The Great Human Transformation' and 'Revisiting Greenvine' in Free Mode.
4. Fixed the issue where cards with the same name couldn’t be smelted (if you've run into this, feel free to reach out to us for help).
5. Fixed the issue where after reaching level 20, [Tępa Podkowa] would replace the selectable relic.
6. Added new side quests in Free Mode for 'Semir', 'Leo', 'Gloria', 'Quintina', 'Shire', 'Rena', 'Modima', 'Anonymous', 'Frend', and 'Mayall'.
7. Added new promotion quests in Free Mode for 'Sayerinne', 'Kena', 'Shire', and 'Delia'.

Huge thanks to our translators for their fantastic support in our Polish localization:

 Denis Kuśpit denirs1
 Agata Balas aga
 Mateusz "Mkaliuszek" Kalicki

notes.title: Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross - Patch 3 Update Announcement (V1.0.04)
notes.content:
Hi Fellows!

Please find the main updates contents as below: (11pm (GMT+8), 1th August))

I. New Additions

1.Introduction of Teammates' Exclusive Store
The Exclusive Store will provide sales of exclusive teammate cards and holy relics that have been unlocked via storyline achievements.

2.Addition of the Sacred Relic Backpack
Click the top left button on the main map to enter the Sacred Relic Backpack. You are free to select the active Sacred Relics, and all the obtained Sacred Relics will always remain in the Sacred Relic Backpack.

3. Addition of Level-Up Tasks
You can now participate in the new level-up tasks at the Camp - Trial Site. Select these tasks to gain gold coins and experience.

4. Addition of a New Teammate Recall Function
Head over to the Camp - Recruitment Site to access the teammate recall function. Here, you can recall former teammates without spending any gold coins.

5. Addition of Teammate Level Preservation Feature
After an upgrade, the levels of your teammates will be perpetually saved. The levels will not be cleared with game cycles.

6. Addition of 25 New Related Cards
Added 25 new cards that can be acquired throughout the course of battle.

II. Optimization

 Optimized the descriptive text of some cards;
 Optimized the triggering probability of events such as "Eris," "Evan," and "Encounter Guided by Stars";
 Optimized the activation logic of the Sacred Relic Atlas.
 Optimized and significantly reduced the difficulty for Recruit, Knight,and Lord.


III. Fixes

 Fixed the issue concerning the artifact "Philosopher's Stone";
 Fixed the intermittent disappearance of the camp exit button;
 Addressed the issue of card malfunction after fixed operations in Level 5-5;
 Corrected the display error in the card illustration manual upon initial game entry;
 Resolved the issue where achievements could not be synced with cloud saves;
 Fixed the problem of the card "Repeat" incorrectly affecting some cards for the second time;
 Rectified the issue with map layer display.
 Fixed issues with some achievements triggering abnormally;
 Solved the problem of teammates unlocked in Challenge Mode being recruitable in Story Mode.

notes.title: “Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross” Raises its Battle Flag and Launches Today
notes.content:
Hi Fellows!

Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross, which is releasing today on Steam! Step back into the age of knights and noble lords , go on a journey with this story-driven deckbuilding RPG featuring more than 30 unique teammates, each with their own special skills and stories. 

Experience the epic 15th century struggle of the Polish-Lithuanian Alliance against the Teutonic Knights, as was told in the Nobel Prize winning novel Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross. To help even further immerse players in the world of the book western-style Character Portraits are being added as free DLC alongside the launch of the game. These new characters portraits add a more serious air to the events of the story for those who crave that extra authenticity.

Build your team, build your deck, and take to the field today with Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross, available now on Steam for $15.99 USD with a 10% off launch discount!

https://youtu.be/qKgZhoeYgQ0

https://youtu.be/-g2_RTUAOK4

About Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross

In a story is adapted from the Nobel Prize-winning work “Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross” by Henryk Sienkiewicz, you'll experience the life and death struggles between the Polish-Lithuanian people and the aggressive Teutonic Knights of the 15th century.

Play as a knight, embark on the medieval adventure, search for companions, collect diverse cards, and help Polish-Lithuanian Alliance defeat the Teutonic Knights in the Battle of Grunwald.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/ca3143f0c1debab1008fb38b4bf3043c2584228d.gif

Key features:

 Teammate skills play a crucial role in combat, with how you play your hand triggering those skills.
 More than 30 teammates can be recruited and leveled up. All of which have unique skills and storylines of their own.
 Build your own combat style with different cards, teammates, and relics, ensuring no run is the same.
 Experience a massive, epic medieval adventure with 7 chapters and over 200 side requests and events.
 Once you're done with the main campaign, there is a roguelite mode providing more even challenges and replayability

notes.title: 《十字军骑士》新人指南，你想知道的都在这里
notes.content:
各位尊敬的骑士们大家好啊，我是吟游诗人小琪，很高兴又见面了。随着我们首次DEMO测试正式结束，《十字军骑士》将会加大马力，全速进入预发售前的准备阶段，我们将会以最大的诚意去打磨游戏，尽力带来优秀的游戏体验，也感谢长久以来一直支持我们的各位骑士们。

在DEMO测试结束后不久，小琪我也收到了好多骑士们反馈过来的问题，因此本次也特意准备了新人指南，就是为了解答各位骑士们的疑惑哦。


1.《十字军骑士》是一款什么样的游戏
简单版：打牌RPG游戏
豪华版：《十字军骑士》是一款以卡牌玩法为主的RPG角色扮演游戏（说人话就是打牌），在卡牌战斗的同时加入了伙伴技能连携系统，根据玩家打出的牌释放不同的专属技能从而构筑万千流派（三消Pro Plus Max版）。您将会在游戏中结识并招募到众多同伴（划重点，小姐姐超多），踏上一段波澜壮阔的旅程。

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/42c2b654830800a21bf91aed450a5c3930d4775f.png

2.这款游戏是手游吗？
如假包换的PC单机游戏，不联网，不抽卡，一次买断不氪金，不过我们之后可能考虑会推出移动版本。

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/e76180ae5cd691b95f5e6bc3dc49ee6bd4f0df75.png

3.游戏的特色和主要玩法是什么？
《十字军骑士》虽然是一款打牌游戏，但是招募的队友也同样重要，可以通过依次打出卡牌的种类，触发同伴的连携技能，不同队友也拥有不同的技能和定位，可以依照战局的不同进行策略性的选择。偷偷告诉你们一个小秘密，如果当局释放队友的终极大招，就会有好看的动态特效哦。

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/05a28bd7ccf1523abaf28ba1d8f28c6c243f8eb1.png

4.队友可以让玩家去选择攻击目标吗？
队友系统无法让玩家自主选择攻击目标，不过由于不同技能拥有不同的攻击规则，比如有些同伴技能是攻击最近敌人，有的是攻击最远敌人，有的是攻击血最少的敌人。依靠策略性的调配，是可以做到“指哪打哪”的。

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/d1e85f466868e1b74b96cd3413b909b44f133085.png

5.请问第二幕的NPC奶妈多大啊？
你猜！

6.为什么营地里有时候没有能招募的NPC？
营地里的NPC是随机到访的，具体可以从左下角的信息栏里看到当前到访NPC的信息。

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/a652a5f8bf7b6c8647044efaf42c6149ed6bb981.png

7.圣遗物有什么用？我应该从哪获得？
圣遗物可以看作是游戏中的被动道具加成，不同功能的圣遗物还有不同的品级，可以通过配合同伴来打造自己的专属流派。目前除了商店购买之外，完成特殊剧情也会获得特殊的圣遗物，大部分同伴我们也加入了专属圣遗物，可以通过完成同伴任务获得。

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/f6313d0650e94ab1f68d41d772cd177072f03db1.png

8.降低卡组下限到底是什么意思，为什么有时候我组的卡牌保存不了。
《十字军骑士》和一些卡牌游戏不同的是，有卡组下限数量的设计，玩家必须要带够一定数量的卡牌，这个卡组才会保存，而降低卡组下限数量则是可以让玩家带更少的牌，配合着同伴的技能系统，通过快速过牌和组合特定的卡牌排序，从而反复快速打出想要的技能组合。

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/870e95fb447c20738193e12cb9bac9812512852d.png

9.后续上线之后还会有什么新玩法吗？
相信各位早已注意到了，主界面的肉鸽模式，目前这个模式我们还在打磨和优化，将会在游戏正式发售之后的一段时间内上线这个新模式，相信到时候会给各位带来不同的体验。

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/1b98efb7368d5f7ad66b21b9a581a096c0fc81f6.png

10.我有一些问题和BUG，在哪能反馈？
欢迎加入我们的骑士QQ群729921218，对游戏有任何建议或意见，都欢迎来加群反馈哦。

11.这游戏什么时候发售，多少钱，我现在就要玩。
目前《十字军骑士》暂定于7月左右正式发售，具体时间请关注我们的后续信息。至于售价，小琪我拿人格保证，绝对是一个能让大家大呼良心的价格。我们将会在6月19日Steam新品节再次上架一个更加稳定的DEMO进行测试，各位小伙伴一定要记着来玩哦。
